headline: Honeywell Technologies Announces Quarterly Dividend
summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C., July 24, 2026--Honeywell Technologies (NASDAQ: HON) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend payment of $0.70 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on September 4, 2026, out of surplus to holders of record at the close of business on August 14, 2026.
